parsed.rationale_overall: System A demonstrates deeper personalization by repeatedly tying recommendations to specific profile attributes (legacy goal, variable consulting income, $4M target math, loss comfort 8/10) and provides more concrete, time-bound actions with dollar amounts. System B is competent and directly addresses the energy question with a useful hold recommendation, but includes more unsupported macro claims (specific PMI, OPEC cheating, $150B AI spend) and less granular execution guidance.
